name: hang
description: A single step that sleeps far longer than any test's timeout_ms or cancel window, so the job is reliably still 'running' — used for agy_cancel and deadline/timeout tests (docs/04 #10, #11: pgrep -g <pgid> must be empty afterwards). The delay is deliberately large (60s) since the test is expected to cancel or let the deadline fire long before it would ever complete naturally.
